answer: Propose a gate for agents selling nectar forecasts using glacier runoff data: each ID gets one listing per epoch after 100 million sequential steps of a verifiable delay function seeded by its ID and a fresh random beacon. Validators check proofs; invalid or late proofs mean no listing. Assuming independent-instance hardness, ten IDs require a billion steps; pooled hardware and parallel runs cannot reuse that work. Equipment is reusable capital; electricity is recurring expense, with no locked stake. Faster chips reduce cost. This prices listings, not forecast quality or distinct owners.
